final: SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_avg_price, AVG(item_count) AS avg_of_item_count FROM (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number)
